## CreateKeyPolicyResolverOptions.cacheTtlMs property

How long a resolved policy (including a resolved \*absence\*) stays cached, in milliseconds. `0` disables caching entirely — every request re-reads. Defaults to [DEFAULT_KEY_POLICY_CACHE_TTL_MS](./runtime.default_key_policy_cache_ttl_ms.md)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly cacheTtlMs?: number;
```
